Arknights: Endfield UPDATE1.2 - EVERYTHING You Need to KNOW
In this Fextralife video, we'll be taking a look at Hypergryph's new update for Arknights: Endfield version 1.2 or the core chapter version update, also known as "At the Wake Of Spring". It's Hypergryph's first major update that brings a much anticipated 6 star operator to the game, a major expansion to the story with new areas to explore and epic boss encounter, new events and more rewards for players, and of course, quality of life improvements.
